findings.summary: CA-BANNON-EPSTEIN INTELLIGENCE PIPELINE ASSESSMENT: The evidence supports a three-node intelligence chain with INDIRECT but structurally significant connections. NODE 1: Bannon was VP of Cambridge Analytica (Jun 2014-Aug 2016, LittleSis rel #1320305). CA was subsidiary of SCL Group (founded by Nigel Oakes). SCL conducted military psyops, election influence campaigns, and behavioral research for NATO, UK MOD, US State Dept. NODE 2: Bannon entered Epstein orbit Jan 2018 (brokered by Kahn/Brock Pierce Nov 2016, EFTA02669093). Bannon and Epstein exchanged 160+ emails and held 19+ in-person meetings Jan 2018-Jun 2019. They shared intelligence on hacking/cyber ops (EFTA02505281), European politics (EFTA02601042), and Bannon offered to rebuild Epstein image through documentary. NODE 3: Epstein had separate intelligence relationships with Israeli firms (Carbyne/Barak, Nardello surveillance) and parallel private intelligence operations (SoftBank/Benedetti/Giannakopoulos). CRITICAL GAP: No evidence that Bannon used CA/SCL capabilities directly for Epstein. The Bannon-Epstein relationship was POLITICAL and MEDIA focused, not intelligence-operational. Bannon was an intelligence CONSUMER, not a provider -- he sought Epstein's financial contacts for his European movement. Epstein was the provider of intelligence sophistication.
